title: Welcome to FlowVoice Notes 🎙️
content:
## Welcome to your voice-powered scratchpad!

This is your private, offline note-taking hub, inspired by Wispr Flow.

### How to use:
- **Dictate directly into this note**: Click the **Start Dictation** button above, or press **F8** anywhere while this window is active!
- **Formatting**: Supports markdown headers (`##`), bullet points, and quick voice commands.
- **Voice Commands**: Say *'new line'* for line breaks, *'comma'* for `,`, or *'period'* for `.`.

Enjoy 100% private, offline speech-to-text without limits!
